_comment: Per-cart manifest for the built-in iso-defender cart, served at /cart.voxbox.json. This is what keeps engine code free of iso-defender specifics: anything the host would otherwise hardcode about one cart lives here as data. Drop a <cart>.voxbox.json beside any other cart to do the same.
name: iso-defender (built-in)
_persistGlobals: The cart predates any Voxatron storage API, so its README documents hiscore and level unlocks as session-only. Naming them here restores them across reloads. 'max' means never restore downward, which is what monotonic values want; a plain array would restore as saved. Carts that use cartdata/dget/dset need none of this.
_camera: Matches the original Voxatron framing in iso-defender/game.jpg — tighter than the engine default, which frames the whole volume because an unknown cart may draw anywhere in it. ?cam=/?tgt=/?fov= still override.
_groundZ: Deliberately absent. The engine derives the shadow plane from the volume each frame, and on this cart that lands on z=50 — the same value 01_config.lua uses — so pinning it here would only hide a regression in the derivation. Set a number to pin it, or false to turn drop shadows off.
_sfx: Omitted: the built-in cart's pack is served at /sfx.json and picked up by the sidecar convention. Other carts can put a pack URL here, or inline the whole spec.
_note: Keys starting with _ are comments; the loader ignores them.
